mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HDOC_VARIABLES WHERE VARIABLE = #{variable}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO HDOC_VARIABLES ( VARIABLE, TYPE, DESCRIPTION, REGISTER_DATETIME, REGISTER_USER, REGISTER_PROCESS, UPDATE_DATETIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_PROCESS ) VALUES ( #{variable}, #{type}, #{description}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{registerUser}, #{registerProcess}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updateUser}, #{updateProcess} )
mapper.update: UPDATE HDOC_VARIABLES SET TYPE = #{type}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, UPDATE_DATETIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UPDATE_USER = #{updateUser}, UPDATE_PROCESS = #{updateProcess} WHERE VARIABLE = #{variable}
